request.style: English, African-American spiritual, deep weathered male lead calling out each line, congregation answering in rich harmony, hand claps and foot stomps on a wooden floor, no instruments, slow and heavy, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Moses went down to Pharaoh's land
Let my people go
With a shepherd's staff in his hand
Let my people go
The Lord has seen his people cry
Let my people go
He heard them under the burning sky
Let my people go

[Chorus]
Tell old Pharaoh, the Lord has spoken
Every chain is going to be broken
Tell old Pharaoh, we're marching on
Out of the night and into the dawn

[Verse]
Pharaoh's heart was cold as stone
Let my people go
But Israel did not walk alone
Let my people go
Through the water, through the sea
Let my people go
The Lord will set his children free
Let my people go

[Chorus]
Tell old Pharaoh, the Lord has spoken
Every chain is going to be broken
Tell old Pharaoh, we're marching on
Out of the night and into the dawn
